description: This file defines the 'DdlReaderErrors' class, which is used to collect and manage errors reported by a DDL parser within the MigraDoc.DocumentObjectModel.IO namespace. It provides methods to add errors, access errors by index, count errors of level 'Error', and iterate through the collection.

classes.name: DdlReaderErrors
classes.description: A collection class used to store and manage errors reported during DDL parsing.

methods.name: AddError
methods.description: Adds a DdlReaderError instance to the internal error list.

methods.name: this[int index]
methods.description: Provides access to a specific error by index.

methods.name: ErrorCount
methods.description: Returns the number of errors at the Error level.

methods.name: GetEnumerator
methods.description: Returns an enumerator to iterate through the error collection.
